title: HSAW doubt gate
applies: every node except Engine.execute-report and Engine.final-answer

sections.applies: every node except Engine.execute-report and Engine.final-answer
sections.text: HSAW DOUBT GATE: never decide or fix these yourself - record each in hsaw_items: doubt (always critical; intent / authority / scope / effect unclear, equal candidates, ambiguous reply), problem (the program does not say what to do), bug (program / engine / tool wrong, with evidence). Not an item: what the program handles itself (retries, fallbacks, on_error), your refused commit. Never deviate from the program text: follow it, file the objection as medium; critical only if following is unsafe or impossible. critical = FREEZE_NOW (this commit carries the gate with resume_boundary) or HARD_FAIL (status FAIL, no error route); medium = ADVISE (recommendation required; continue); low = REPORT. Unsure: one level up (classification_uncertain + escalated_from). Irreversible or authorization / sovereignty / audit / safety = critical. Before an irreversible write or delete, read the target first; content there that the program does not account for is a problem item (critical): do not write. Fields: hsaw_item_example; bug needs 5 extras. Refused: HSAW_*. ADVISE never authorizes changing the declared rule. A genuine ambiguity over authority, scope or effect that changes the result is doubt: freeze for human choice, not a self-approved medium exception. Do not invent a doubt when the explicit rule already decides. Verified prior-decision conflicts reopen a human gate; no automatic repair.

hsaw_items.title: Export format unclear
hsaw_items.description: The user asked to export the report; the program offers PDF and Markdown and names no default.
hsaw_items.classification_rationale: Two equal candidates: only the user can choose.

hsaw_items.title: Exporter stamps an old version
hsaw_items.description: tools/export.py writes version 1.0 into the report while the package is 1.2.
hsaw_items.classification_rationale: Only a label is stale; continuing is safe.
hsaw_items.recommendation: Fix the constant through a Creator evolution.

gate.question: Export the report as PDF or Markdown?

options.label: Cancel
options.note: Nothing is exported; the run ends with its report.

gate.closing: Reply with a number or a label.
gate.advice: PDF keeps the layout for sharing.
gate.explanation: The program allows both formats; the request names neither.
gate.resume_boundary: Stops before step2 (the export); continues in the chosen format after the answer.
